card.literal: Even an elephant's foot slips.
card.meaning: Anyone can make a mistake; don't be hard on yourself.

card.literal: When hunger comes, the ten (virtues) fly away.
card.meaning: Hunger overrides everything; eat before anything else.

card.literal: That is your head-writing.
card.meaning: Fate; what is written on your forehead at birth.

src_text: நீ சொன்னதை கேட்டதும் வயித்துல பால் வார்த்த மாதிரி இருந்துச்சு.
src_roman: Nee sonnadhai kettadhum vayithula paal vaartha maadhiri irundhuchu.
gloss: What you said was a huge relief.

card.source: நீ சொன்னதை கேட்டதும் வயித்துல பால் வார்த்த மாதிரி இருந்துச்சு.
card.literal: It was like milk poured into my stomach.
card.meaning: Deep relief and joy.

gloss: It did my heart good to see you.

card.literal: I saw you until my eyes cooled.
card.meaning: Seeing something heart-warming to full satisfaction.

gloss: We must ward off the evil eye.

card.literal: The eye will fall; must circle and cast it off.
card.meaning: Admiration can attract the evil eye; a salt-and-chilli ritual wards it off.

src_text: போறதுக்கு முன்னாடி ஒரு வார்த்தை சொல்லிட்டு போ.
src_roman: Poradhukku munnaadi oru vaarthai sollittu po.

card.source: போறதுக்கு முன்னாடி ஒரு வார்த்தை சொல்லிட்டு போ.
card.literal: Say one word and go.
card.meaning: Let me know before you go; don't vanish without a word.

card.literal: Did you eat?
card.meaning: The standard affectionate greeting; it means 'I care about you', not a literal question.

card.literal: I'm biting my teeth.
card.meaning: Enduring pain or hardship silently.

card.literal: Then the heart became stone.
card.meaning: Numbed by grief; hardened emotionally.

card.literal: The time isn't passing at all.
card.meaning: I'm bored and lonely; a gentle plea for company.

card.literal: The heart didn't listen.
card.meaning: I couldn't bring myself to do it.

card.literal: She has hand-luck.
card.meaning: Whatever she cooks or starts turns out well.

card.literal: Give by the scoopful; it won't run short.
card.meaning: Be generous; giving freely doesn't diminish you.

card.literal: You will live a hundred years!
card.meaning: Said when someone appears just as they were being talked about.

card.literal: You can't hide a whole pumpkin in rice.
card.meaning: Big truths cannot be hidden.

card.literal: You can't straighten a dog's tail.
card.meaning: Some people never change.

card.literal: Does a donkey know the scent of camphor?
card.meaning: Something fine is wasted on one who can't appreciate it.

card.literal: The wolf wept that the goat was getting wet.
card.meaning: False sympathy; crocodile tears.

src_text: எலி வளையா இருந்தாலும் தனி வளையா இருக்கணும்.
src_roman: Eli valaiyaa irundhaalum thani valaiyaa irukkanum.

card.source: எலி வளையா இருந்தாலும் தனி வளையா இருக்கணும்.
card.literal: Even a rat hole should be your own hole.
card.meaning: A home of your own matters more than its size.

card.literal: Finally God opened his eyes.
card.meaning: At last, justice or good fortune has arrived.

card.literal: Say it like slipping a needle into a banana.
card.meaning: Give advice so smoothly it isn't felt as criticism.

gloss: It pains me to think of it.

card.literal: Thinking of it, my stomach burns.
card.meaning: Burning anguish (or envy), depending on context.

card.literal: Let's see one hand.
card.meaning: Let's try it / take them on.

card.literal: He talks with no salt, no taste.
card.meaning: Bland talk with no substance.

card.literal: His tongue is too long.
card.meaning: Talks back; cheeky.

card.literal: Now he's a snake that lost its teeth.
card.meaning: Someone once feared who is now harmless.

card.literal: His nose broke.
card.meaning: He lost face; was humiliated.

card.literal: I washed my hands.
card.meaning: I've disowned the matter; I'm done.

card.literal: Next week they're going to see a girl.
card.meaning: The family is visiting a prospective bride, the arranged-marriage custom.

card.literal: Be like a king.
card.meaning: A blessing: live comfortably and without struggle.

card.literal: Oh, sin!
card.meaning: Sympathy ('poor thing'), not an accusation.

card.literal: He should be beaten with a slipper.
card.meaning: An expression of strong contempt, not a literal threat.

card.literal: With elders, not 'nee', say 'neenga'.
card.meaning: Tamil marks respect in the pronoun; use the plural form with elders.

gloss: The vegetable-seller lady asked after you.

card.literal: The vegetable-shop elder-sister asked about you.
card.meaning: 'Akka' here is polite address to an unrelated woman, not your sister.

src_text: அரசன் அன்று கொல்வான், தெய்வம் நின்று கொல்லும்.
src_roman: Arasan andru kolvaan, dheivam nindru kollum.
gloss: Divine justice is slow but sure.

card.source: அரசன் அன்று கொல்வான், தெய்வம் நின்று கொல்லும்.
card.literal: The king kills at once; God kills standing by.
card.meaning: Divine justice is slow but certain.

card.literal: That word is worth a thousand gold.
card.meaning: Priceless; deeply valued.

src_text: கல்யாணம் பண்ணிப் பாரு, வீடு கட்டிப் பாரு.
src_roman: Kalyaanam pannip paaru, veedu kattip paaru.
gloss: Both are harder than they look.

card.source: கல்யாணம் பண்ணிப் பாரு, வீடு கட்டிப் பாரு.
card.literal: Try holding a wedding, try building a house.
card.meaning: Both are far harder than they look.

src_text: அடி உதவுற மாதிரி அண்ணன் தம்பி உதவ மாட்டான்.
src_roman: Adi udhavura maadhiri annan thambi udhava maattaan.

card.source: அடி உதவுற மாதிரி அண்ணன் தம்பி உதவ மாட்டான்.
card.literal: Even brothers won't help you like a beating does.
card.meaning: Discipline teaches what kindness cannot. ('annan', 'thambi' are generic here, not your relatives.)

card.literal: He wanders with a towel over his head.
card.meaning: Avoiding people out of shame.

card.literal: He won't even move his thumb.
card.meaning: He won't lift a finger to help.

card.literal: Like searching for a black cat in the dark.
card.meaning: A futile search.

gloss: It's very hot in Madurai today.
The knee pain has eased a little.
They say it'll rain this week.
I went to the temple yesterday.
They've announced a power cut tomorrow.
Your uncle is coming next week.
I'm watching the news on TV.
It's Friday; I lit the lamp.

src_text: பக்கத்து வீட்டு நாய் ராத்திரி முழுக்க குரைச்சுது.
src_roman: Pakkathu veettu naai raathiri muzhukka kuraichudhu.
gloss: The neighbour's dog barked all night.
The curry-leaf plant has grown well.
I need to change my glasses.
The power bill is high this month.
Has your dad come back from the office?
The flower-seller didn't bring jasmine today.

src_text: எனக்கு காது கொஞ்சம் கேக்கலை, சத்தமா பேசு.
src_roman: Enakku kaadhu konjam kekkalai, sathamaa pesu.
gloss: I can't hear well; speak louder.
I read the paper every day.
I have an eye operation next month.
I've put clothes to dry on the terrace.
I walked to the bus stop.
Pongal is on January 14 this year.
The house needs a new coat of paint.
I didn't go to buy vegetables today.
